about: Where a room goes in the conversation lists by its membership. An invitation, to a workspace too, is listed with the conversations, where it can be accepted or declined; only a joined workspace joins the workspace picker; a room you left or were banned from is not listed. space says whether the room is a workspace.

placement.name: An invitation to a workspace stays an invitation
A joined workspace joins the picker
An invitation to a conversation is listed
A workspace you left is not listed
A conversation you were banned from is not listed
